correctness.rationale: For every r in (0,1) and real b, Legendre recurrence gives normalized eigenvalues λ_n=r^n(1+bR_n(r²)). Exact rational identities show R_n increases strictly from R_0=r² to supremum R_inf=(3+2r²+3r⁴)/(8r²), attained at no finite n, with R_inf−R_n∼3(1−r⁴)/(8r²n). Schoenberg’s complete isotropic S² criterion proves iff b≥−1/R_inf. All coefficients remain >0 at equality, and density of spherical harmonics for finite atomic measures proves strict finite-point positive definiteness. Substitution yields the critical multiplier constant. Check.py from the actual new package path passed 3318 exact and high-precision assertions; finite testing is supplementary, not the all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: Signed angular modulation of the most basic spherical harmonic smoothing/covariance kernel is a motivated global positivity problem. The threshold is sharp at every radius, but no finite harmonic degree controls it; at equality all finite harmonic channels remain strictly positive even as their relative gap is O(1/n). This identifies a true high-frequency admissibility barrier and an exact critical smoothing law useful in covariance/spherical interpolation design, beyond a finite test or normalization exercise.
